prompt:
A manifest hash is computed over a seed object that includes a digest of the prompt template. The manifest written to disk contains the provider, model, variant, question-set hash, and the resulting manifest hash — but not the template digest itself.

A later tool wants to confirm two artifacts were produced under the same template. The only template-derived value available to it is the manifest hash, which also varies with the variant.

Decide whether the tool can verify template identity from what is stored.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
